source_snapshot.procedure_direct_xlsx: 【Before Test】 1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition. 2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.). 3. The following BIOS settings paths are from the Intel reference platform. Locations of these settings may be different on your BIOS implementation Customer Scripts (CScripts) Enabling The following is a quick reference of the key BIOS knobs for CScripts: • EDKII > Socket Configuration > Processor Configuration > Lock Chipset = Disable • EDKII > Socket Configuration > Processor Configuration > MSR Lock Control = Disable • EDKII > Socket Configuration > IIO Configuration > DFX Global Configuration > — EV DFX Features = Enable — Disable BIOS Done = [X] ELOG Enabling • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > eMCA Settings > — EMCA Error Support= Enable — EMCA Logging Support= Enable — Corrected Error eLog = Enable — Memory Error eLog = Enable — Processor Error eLog = Enable Error Reporting Enabling • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > WHEA Settings > — WHEA Support = Enable — WHEA Log Memory Error = Enable — WHEA Log Processor Error = Enable — WHEA Log PCI Error = Enable Error Injection Enabling • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > — System Errors = Enable — System Memory Poison = Enable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > Error Injection Settings > — MCA Bank Error Injection Support = Enable — WHEA Error Injection Support = Enable — WHEA PCIe* Error Injection Support = Enable — WHEA PCIe* Error Action Table = Enable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > IIO Error Enabling > — IIO/PCH Global Error Support = Enable — IIO MCA Support = Disable — IIO eDPC Support = Disable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > PCIE Error Enabling > PCIe* Corrected Error Threshold Counter = Disable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > PCIE Error Enabling > PCIe AER Corrected Errors = Enable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > EMCA Settings > LMCE Support = Enable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > Memory Error Enabling > Memory Corrected Error = Enable • EDKII > Socket Configuration > Uncore Configuration > Uncore General Configuration > Directory Mode Enable = Disable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > Miscellaneous Configuration > Enable DAM Pin = Enable Firmware First Model • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > EMCA Settings > — EMCA Logging Support = Enable — EMCA CMCI-SMI Morphing = EMCA gen2 CSMI — EMCA CMCI-SMI Threshold = 0 — EMCA MCA-SMI Enable = EMCA gen 2 - MSMI • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > IIO Error Enabling > OS Native AER Support = Disable Crash Log • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > Crash Log Enabling > CPU CrashLog Feature = Disable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > Crash Log Enabling > PCH CrashLog Feature = Disable 4. Other OS Notes You can use grub2-mkconfig to specify "ras=cec_disable" by modifying /etc/default/grub's "GRUB_CMDLINE_LINUX" with "ras=cec_disable". 【During Test】 1. Uncorrectable Error in a Mirrored Region specific BIOS setup : • EDKII > Socket Configuration > Memory Configuration > Memory RAS Configuration > — UEFI ARM Mirror = Enable — ARM Mirror Percentage = 10 — Patrol Scrub = Enable at End of Post — Mirror TAD0 = Enable • EDKII > Platform Configuration > System Event Log > — RAS Log Level = MID (BASIC_FLOW, FUNC_FLOW) • EDKII > Platform Configuration > Miscellaneous Configuration > — Serial Debug Message Level > Normal 2. Halt the system and verify that mirroring is enabled by reading mode.mirror >>> halt() >>> sv.sockets.compute0.uncore.memss.b2cmis.mode.mirror 3. Check the memory configuration to verify that the system is in mirror mode. Directory mode should be disabled and ECC should be enabled. Verify channel mode has P/P or ParMirr which indicates address range memory mirroring. >>> mc.dimminfoNoSPD() 4. Use mc.addTran() to print all valid TAD array entries to find the mirrored address range. >>> mc.addTran() 5. Use the following command to translate how a few address within the specified system address range map to its physical DIMM address. Take note of the memory controller ("mc") column. From this table, system address can be selected to test injecting errors into mirrored regions on different memory controllers. >>> ras.mem.sa2da_table(0x100000000, 0x100000400, 64) 6. Inject an uncorrectable error to an address within the mirrored address region. >>> ei.utils.resetInjectorLockCheck() >>> ei.mem.memDevs(dev0msk=0x3, dev1msk=0x3) >>> ei.mem.injectMemError(0x100000300, errType="uce") 7. Verify the error was corrected. Check B2CMI_STATUS to verify a corrected error was logged. Alternatively, you can read the MCI_STATUS_SHADOW register. >>> sv.socket0.compute0.uncore.memss.b2cmi1.mci_status_shadow >>> sv.socket0.compute0.uncore.memss.b2cmi1.mci_status_shadow.show() 8. Verify in the B2CMI_MISC register that the error was corrected during mirroring and mirror scrub was successful. Alternatively you can read the MCI_MISC_SHADOW register. >>> sv.socket0.compute0.uncore.memss.b2cmi1.mci_misc_shadow >>> sv.socket0.compute0.uncore.memss.b2cmi1.mci_misc_shadow.show() 9. Resume the system to allow all error handling flows to complete. >>> go() 10. FTrace Output. Verify that an ELog record was generated indicated by extlog_mem_event. # cd /sys/kernel/debug/tracing # echo 1 > events/mce/mce_record/enable # echo 1 > events/ras/enable # cat trace_pipe

source_snapshot.deepseek_direct_xlsx: PARTIAL | -- Uncorrectable Error in a Mirrored Region (Intel partial mirror Uncorrectable Error in a Mirrored Region error injection): requires CScripts/EDKII unlock (Lock Chipset=Disable, MSR Lock Control=Disable, EV DFX Features=Enable, WHEA Error Injection Support=Enable) + the user/FAE to drive the Cscript/error-injection harness for this exact pattern. Agent captures the post-injection evidence with sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "dmesg -T 2>&1 | tail -180 | grep -iE 'mirror|uncorrected|uc'; echo __partial_mirror_Uncorrectable_Error_in_a_Mirrored_Region; ipmitool sel elist 2>&1 | tail -40 2>&1".

disposition_reason: Partial mirroring only protects configured address intervals, so the literal address is not sufficient evidence; TAD and sa2da must prove membership and controller mapping for this boot. A corrected B2CMI record plus mirror-scrub status proves hardware recovery, while extlog_mem_event proves the firmware-first notification path. Both are needed because either alone leaves half the source intent untested. Reinjection could create unrelated trace records and is prohibited. test_case.test_name: Uncorrectable Error in a Mirrored Region — retained controlled review-layer procedure
test_case.purpose: Verify that a UCE inside the configured 10% address-range-mirrored region is corrected from the mirror, scrub completes, and firmware-first logging reaches Linux FTrace.
required_package: CScripts version/hash/license plus project BIOS path mappings
Approved ARM Mirror10%/TAD0/patrol-scrub topology and sa2da output
Address0x100000300-to-DIMM/MC/b2cmi1 mapping and B2CMI field oracle
FTrace availability/timing, serial/OOB recovery and knob restoration plan
test_case.test_command: Record platform and baseline; configure the literal ARM Mirror/TAD/patrol/RAS/debug knobs; halt and prove mirror mode, directory off, ECC on and P/P or ParMirr; enumerate TAD and translate the sample range; only if0x100000300 is mirrored, reset lock, set both device masks0x3 and inject one UCE; read b2cmi1 status/misc raw and decoded; go; enable MCE/RAS trace events and capture extlog_mem_event; restore settings and verify health.
test_case.expected_result: Error is injected successfully. Error logs should match.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No executable PASS verdict exists yet for Uncorrectable Error in a Mirrored Region. The protected Criteria is `Error is injected successfully. Error logs should match.`; it becomes enforceable only after resolving: Resolve Reliability row168 Wistron-System RAS-00125-V002: approve GNR/BIOS/BMC/OS, DIMM topology, Intel CScripts version/hash/license and project mappings for ARM Mirror10%, Patrol Scrub end-of-POST, Mirror TAD0, RAS MID and serial Normal; provide TAD/sa2da proof that0x100000300 is mirrored and maps to b2cmi1, exact corrected/mirror-scrub fields and extlog_mem_event timing, plus OOB no-retry recovery/restoration.
safety_gate: Dedicated workload-free SUT with live serial/OOB
Preserve baseline logs; do not clear away unrelated evidence
Do not inject unless target is proven inside mirrored range and b2cmi1 mapping is approved
One injection only; stop on wrong severity, register mismatch, hang or missing recovery
Restore ARM/TAD/patrol/debug/injection settings and verify memory/OS/BMC health
expected_evidence: mode.mirror, dimminfo directory/ECC/P-P or ParMirr, addTran and sa2da mapping
b2cmi1 status showing corrected event and misc showing mirror correction/scrub success
Timestamped FTrace extlog_mem_event plus supporting serial/OS/BMC logs
Restoration, post-test health and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Reference EDKII paths and compute/socket namespaces may differ; translations must preserve the same knobs and b2cmi instance. ARM percentage and TAD0 layout cannot be inferred from the address literal alone.
